title: Summary card
description: KPI card: a title, a prominent metric, an optional decorative sparkline beside it and an optional footer line. Built on Card; the sparkline is a private descendant drawn with visx primitives.

anatomy.description: Card with data-slot="summary-card"; props are title, metric, trend, footer, className.

Private visx LinePath, aria-hidden, no axes or tooltip; fills its flex slot's width, fixed height. Colors come from --juni-* vars applied through CSS classes because SVG presentation attributes cannot hold var().

usage: Pass the metric as a ReactNode so units and deltas can be marked up by the caller.
The sparkline is decorative: the metric text MUST carry the information on its own.
Charts take colors only from the palette via CSS classes so they re-theme live with light/dark.
